description: Published MACE-MP-MOF0 v2 model. Native MACE multi-head fine-tune of MACE-MP-0b medium: pt_head (MP trajectory replay, 1000 structures, weight 1.0) + pbe_d3 (MOF PBE+D3). ~2500 epochs, loss weights energy:forces:stress = 1:10:100, float64, EMA 0.995, seed 2024.

paper.title: Machine learned potential for high-throughput phonon calculations of metal-organic frameworks

published_reference_numbers.note: From the reproduction task card; released test split, native MACE eval code. Context only — the binding baseline is baseline_scores.json produced by benchmark/evaluation/evaluate_mof0.py.

baseline_scorecard_status: NOT_YET_GENERATED -- run benchmark/baselines/mace_mof0/run_baseline.sh inside the evaluation Docker image on GPU. It scores foundation / mofs_v1 / mofs_v2 with the frozen evaluator, copies the mofs_v2 scorecard to baseline_scores.json, writes baseline_context.json, and produces benchmark/evaluation/noise_estimate.json. Then: python benchmark/integrity/verify_frozen.py --update && commit.
provenance_rules: The binding baseline is the scorecard this repo generates with the frozen evaluator, not the paper's printed numbers.
If the evaluator changes, baseline_scores.json is regenerated in the same commit and the frozen manifest is updated.
Candidate and baseline are always scored by the same evaluator_rev.
